sentences.zh: 当他绕过沙洲驶入水域时，他意识到了布吕埃斯防线的这一点，即法国人给自己和海岸之间留出了一条通道。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Pouring fire, all this metal, the cannonballs, the metal, the shrapnel, whatever, into the sides of the first French ship.

sentences.en: And just to say also about the French ships, the French aim at the masts, the British don't, they aim at the decks.

sentences.zh: 汤姆，夜幕也正笼罩着拿破仑·波拿巴的雄心壮志。

sentences.zh: 左舷的船只基本上都被击溃了。

sentences.en: Yeah, the first five French ships.
sentences.zh: 对，前五艘法国军舰。

sentences.zh: 也就是斯巴达人号、雷电号、勇士号。

sentences.en: And now they've got the ships in the middle of the line.
sentences.zh: 现在他们攻击的是战线中间的军舰。

sentences.en: So that is L'Oreal, of course, which we've just been talking about.
sentences.zh: 也就是我们刚才一直在讨论的东方号。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.zh: 你知道的，这艘巨大的三层甲板战舰拥有120门大炮，比英国皇家海军的任何军舰都要大。

sentences.en: And it's flanked on either side by Le Franklin and Le Tonneau, both of which also have more guns than Nelson's own flagship.
sentences.zh: 它的两侧是富兰克林号和雷鸣号的护卫，这两艘船拥有的火炮数量也比纳尔逊自己的旗舰还要多。

sentences.en: So it might seem a tough nut to crack.
sentences.zh: 所以这看起来可能是一块难啃的骨头。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: But Nelson's band of brothers are up for it.
sentences.zh: 但纳尔逊的兄弟连已经准备好了。

sentences.en: So the first to emerge through the smoke and the chaos is Bellerophon, captained by Henry d'Estaer Derby.
sentences.zh: 第一个冲破烟雾和混乱的是柏勒罗丰号，由亨利·代斯特尔·德比指挥。

sentences.en: And this anchors at the stern just as planned, all guns blazing beside the French flagship.
sentences.zh: 正如计划的那样，它在法国旗舰旁边的船尾抛锚，万炮齐发。

sentences.en: It is dwarfed by L'Oreal.
sentences.zh: 在东方号面前，它显得十分渺小。

sentences.en: But for half an hour or so, Derby is just firing and firing and firing.
sentences.zh: 但在大约半个小时的时间里，德比一直在疯狂开火。

sentences.en: And he's taking horrendous punishments himself.
sentences.zh: 他自己也承受了可怕的猛烈打击。

sentences.en: Bellerophon suffers more casualties than any other British ship in the Battle of the Nile.
sentences.zh: 柏勒罗丰号在尼罗河战役中遭受的伤亡比任何其他英国军舰都多。

sentences.en: Almost 200 men, dead or injured.
sentences.zh: 近两百人死伤。

sentences.en: The sail slashed to ribbons, the mast cut down.
sentences.zh: 风帆被撕成条状，桅杆被砍断。

sentences.en: Derby himself is knocked senseless with a head wound.
sentences.zh: 德比本人头部受伤，失去了知觉。

sentences.en: But then after half an hour, two more British ships.
sentences.zh: 但半小时后，又有两艘英国军舰赶到。

sentences.en: See, as each British ship kind of cleans up a French ship, they can then move on to the next.
sentences.zh: 你看，当每艘英国军舰清理掉一艘法国军舰后，就可以转向下一艘。

sentences.en: So the Alexander and the Swift Shore also close in on L'Oreal.
sentences.zh: 所以亚历山大号和雨燕岸号也向东方号逼近。

sentences.en: By about nine o'clock, L'Oreal is in terrible trouble.
sentences.zh: 到九点左右，东方号陷入了极度危险的境地。

sentences.en: So the deck is covered with splinters of wood and basically bits of French sailors.
sentences.zh: 甲板上到处都是木头碎屑和法国水兵的残肢断臂。

sentences.en: Now, among them is the Admiral, Brueis himself.
sentences.zh: 其中就包括海军中将布瑞斯本人。

sentences.en: He has stood there the whole time under the most punishing withering fire.
sentences.zh: 他在最惨烈、最密集的炮火中一直坚守在那里。

sentences.en: He was hit by British fire in the head and in the arm.
sentences.zh: 他的头部和手臂被英国炮火击中。

sentences.en: Unbelievably, he takes a shot to the stomach that almost rips his body in two.
sentences.zh: 难以置信的是，他的腹部中弹，身体几乎被炸成两截。

sentences.en: And his men try to carry the sort of two semi-detached bits of him down.
sentences.zh: 他的手下试图把他那两个半连体的残躯抬下去。

sentences.en: And he says somehow through kind of blood pouring from his head, he says, no, I will die as
sentences.zh: 鲜血从头部涌出，他却不知怎么说道，不，我要像生前一样

sentences.en: I've lived on the deck of my ship.
sentences.zh: 死在我的舰艇甲板上。

sentences.en: And he actually lives for another 15 minutes.
sentences.zh: 他竟然又活了十五分钟。

sentences.en: I mean, amazing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，太惊人了。

sentences.en: And the commander of Le Tonneau as well.
sentences.zh: 雷鸣号的指挥官也是如此。

sentences.en: I mean, just unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，简直难以置信。

sentences.en: He loses both his arms and a leg and he carries on fighting as he slowly bleeds to death.
sentences.zh: 他失去了双臂和一条腿，却在缓缓流尽最后一滴血的同时坚持战斗。

sentences.en: I mean, I have to say throughout this story, indeed, throughout Nelson's entire life and
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我不得不说，贯穿这个故事，甚至贯穿纳尔逊的一生和

sentences.zh: 职业生涯，无一例外，他面对的法国对手在炮火下都表现出卓越的勇气，尽管他们总是被英国人压制。

sentences.zh: 他们总是知道结果会如此，但他们从不放弃。

sentences.zh: 他们没有逃跑。

sentences.en: They don't haul down their colors straight away.
sentences.zh: 他们没有立刻降旗投降。

sentences.zh: 所以夸夸我们的法国朋友挺好的，不是吗，汤姆？

sentences.en: I think it reflects very well on you.

sentences.en: Oh, Tom, that's kind of...
sentences.zh: 噢，汤姆，你真好……

sentences.en: And on the sense of fair play of an Englishman.
sentences.zh: 也体现了一个英国人的公平竞争意识。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a Corinthian spirit, isn't it, really?
sentences.zh: 对，这真是一种骑士精神，不是吗？

sentences.en: So it reflects well on the French, but even more on us.
sentences.zh: 所以这既反映了法国人的优秀，更反映了我们的优秀。

sentences.en: So that's good.
sentences.zh: 这很好。

sentences.en: So let's get back to Lorient.
sentences.zh: 让我们回到东方号。

sentences.zh: 东方号的舰长卡萨比安卡后来怎么了？

sentences.en: He was probably, some sources suggest, hit in the face by debris.
sentences.zh: 一些资料表明，他可能面部被碎片击中。

sentences.en: And he probably was knocked unconscious.
sentences.zh: 他很可能被打得失去了知觉。

sentences.en: And his son was on the ship with him.
sentences.zh: 他的儿子当时也和他在船上。

sentences.en: There are various accounts.
sentences.zh: 有各种各样的说法。

sentences.zh: 有人说他10岁，有人说12岁，有人说13岁。

sentences.en: So he probably didn't stand on the burning deck.
sentences.zh: 所以他大概并没有站在燃烧的甲板上。

sentences.zh: 此时，亚历山大号上的一名见习军官发现东方号的后甲板上有一团亮光，泛着诡异的橙色光芒。

sentences.en: Lorient is on fire.
sentences.zh: 东方号着火了。

sentences.en: And there are different theories about what happened.
sentences.zh: 关于发生了什么，有各种不同的理论。

sentences.zh: 一些历史学家认为东方号没有做好战斗准备。

sentences.zh: 它的后甲板上放了一些油漆罐或油桶，在混乱和烈火中被点燃了。

sentences.en: But Alexander Ball, the captain of the Alexander, said that he had prepared a kind of sort of
sentences.zh: 但亚历山大号的舰长亚历山大·鲍尔说，他曾准备过一种类似

sentences.zh: 希腊火风格的东西。

sentences.zh: 拜占庭式的液体凝固汽油。

sentences.zh: 对，是他为应对最紧急情况而准备的可燃制剂。

sentences.zh: 他说他的一位中尉在不知情的情况下把它扔向了东方号。

sentences.en: The interesting thing there is there's a sort of sense that if that happened, it was illegitimate and it was unsporting.

sentences.en: It was cheating.
sentences.zh: 这是在作弊。

sentences.en: Isn't that extraordinary that they'd got this thing, which clearly was a super weapon.
sentences.zh: 难道不奇怪吗？他们拥有了这样一件显然是超级武器的东西，

sentences.en: And they're like, oh, it would be very bad form to say that we used it.
sentences.zh: 而他们的反应却是，哦，承认我们使用了它，风度会很差。

sentences.en: So the lieutenant did it, but I didn't order it.
sentences.zh: 所以是中尉干的，但我可没下命令。

sentences.en: Like kind of body line.
sentences.zh: 有点像身体线战术。

sentences.en: Anyway, it's possible that it happened, right?
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，这确实可能发生，对吧？

sentences.en: Some bloke threw this, threw the windows of the Alexander onto Lorient.
sentences.zh: 某个家伙通过亚历山大号的舷窗把这东西扔到了东方号上。

sentences.zh: 但关键在于，东方号因为体型巨大，所以携带着相应海量的火药。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And that's why, you know, it's not just people on the ship, but people all around are starting to think, hmm, this is looking a bit dodgy.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么，不仅是船上的人，周围所有人也开始觉得，嗯，这情况有点不妙了。

sentences.en: Because this fire starts to spread very quickly.
sentences.zh: 因为这场火灾开始蔓延得非常快。

sentences.en: It goes up the rigging.
sentences.zh: 它顺着索具往上烧。

sentences.en: Now, the French, of course, have fire pumps aboard.
sentences.zh: 当然，法国人船上是有消防泵的。

sentences.en: All ships have fire pumps to try and deal with this.
sentences.zh: 所有的船都有消防泵来处理这种情况。

sentences.en: But the fire pumps have been smashed to pieces by British shot.
sentences.zh: 但消防泵已经被英国的炮弹砸得粉碎。

sentences.en: A second fire begins at the bow.
sentences.zh: 船头又燃起了第二处大火。

sentences.en: And that means that hundreds of sailors are trapped now in the waist of the ship and they can't get out.
sentences.zh: 这意味着成百上千的水手现在被困在船中部，无法逃生。

sentences.en: The British, of course, keep firing and firing all the time.
sentences.zh: 当然，英国人一直在不停地开火。

sentences.en: The flames are leaping up the rigging of Lorient.
sentences.zh: 烈火在东方号的索具上跳跃。

sentences.en: Black smoke starts to pour from Lorient.
sentences.zh: 浓黑的烟雾开始从东方号中涌出。

sentences.en: And at this point, some of the sailors start trying to jump.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，一些水手开始试图跳船。

sentences.en: They're kind of on fire or they're screaming or whatever.
sentences.zh: 他们身上着了火，或者在尖叫，诸如此类。

sentences.zh: 这时，纳尔逊专门被扶了上来。

sentences.en: Even though he's got blood pouring from his head, he's got a kind of bandage on to see this.
sentences.zh: 尽管他头部血流如注，还缠着绷带，但他还是来看这一幕。

sentences.en: And he can see at once, as everybody can, that the French flagship, this enormous kind of leviathan of the waters is doomed.
sentences.zh: 正如所有人一样，他一眼就能看出，法国旗舰这个水上庞然大物已经无药可救了。

sentences.en: That the fire is now raging unchecked.
sentences.zh: 大火现在已经失去控制，疯狂肆虐。

sentences.en: And so at about this point, when it's clear that the fire can't be stopped, the British and French captains on all sides are kind of rushing to cut their own anchor cables because

sentences.en: they don't want to be caught in the blaSt.
sentences.zh: 因为他们不想被爆炸波及。

sentences.en: They need to be carried away because when the fire reaches the magazine, there will be an explosion, the like of which they have never seen before.
sentences.zh: 他们必须驶离，因为当大火触及弹药库时，将会发生他们从未见过的巨大爆炸。

sentences.en: And Nelson, to his great credit, I think, Tom, says to his lieutenants, prepare to pick up survivors.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，我认为纳尔逊非常值得称赞，他对中尉们说，准备营救幸存者。

sentences.en: You know, this is what we do.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这就是我们所做的。

sentences.en: I mean, this is, again, it's an odd thing about fighting at sea that there is this code, isn't there, of kind of nobility, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这也是海上作战的一个奇怪之处，存在着某种骑士精神的准则，我猜。

sentences.en: There's so much against you, isn't there?
sentences.zh: 有那么多不利因素，不是吗？

sentences.zh: 你既要面对敌人，又要面对大海。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，确实如此。

sentences.en: So about half nine, hundreds of men are trying to jump from Lorient.
sentences.zh: 所以在九点半左右，数百人试图从东方号上跳下来。

sentences.en: But actually, of course, a lot of these sailors cannot swim.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，很多水手根本不会游泳。

sentences.en: I mean, this is a theme of the Master and Commander series, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这也是《怒海争锋》系列的主题，不是吗？

sentences.en: The Patrick O'Brien books.
sentences.zh: 帕特里克·奥布莱恩的书。

sentences.en: Plus, it's very dark and, you know, there's kind of bodies everywhere and bits of, yeah, just terrifying.
sentences.zh: 另外，天色非常黑，你知道的，到处都是尸体和残骸，简直太可怕了。

sentences.en: And then, according to one account, at least, it's a 937 that the fire reaches the magazine of Lorient.
sentences.zh: 根据至少一份记录，火灾是在9点37分蔓延到东方号弹药库的。

sentences.en: And that is the most unbelievable explosion.
sentences.zh: 那是令人难以置信的巨大爆炸。

sentences.en: It's as though the entire French flagship just suddenly turns into this gigantic fireball and the searing kind of white heat of the explosion is felt by everybody across the bay.
sentences.zh: 就好像整个法国旗舰突然变成了一个巨大的火球，湾里的每个人都感受到了爆炸那灼热的白光。

sentences.en: Just boom, this kind of burSt.
sentences.zh: 轰的一声巨响，这就是那种爆发。

sentences.en: And it's heard for kind of miles around, seen for miles around, this great kind of wall of fire spurting up into the sky.
sentences.zh: 方圆数英里都能听到和看到它，一堵巨大的火墙冲向天空。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: People in Alexandria hear it deep into the desert.
sentences.zh: 亚历山大的居民在沙漠深处也能听到。

sentences.en: But, I mean, astonishing.
sentences.zh: 但我的意思是，太惊人了。

sentences.en: If a Hollywood filmmaker is listening, there are the most amazing descriptions.
sentences.zh: 如果有好莱坞电影制作人在听，这里有最精彩的描述。

sentences.en: The whole thing is lit up suddenly.
sentences.zh: 整个场景瞬间被照亮。

sentences.en: It is like it's midday because of the heat and light of this explosion.
sentences.zh: 由于爆炸产生的高温和光芒，感觉就像正午一样。

sentences.en: And the sailors can see suddenly for the first time that on the shore, there are dozens, hundreds of Mameluke and Arab spectators who have been watching the battle unfold.
sentences.zh: 水手们突然第一次看到，岸上有几十个、几百个马穆鲁克和阿拉伯旁观者一直在观看这场战斗的展开。

sentences.en: Captain Miller of Theseus, he said, a most grand and awful spectacle, such as formerly would have drawn tears down the victor's cheeks.
sentences.zh: 忒修斯号的米勒舰长说，这是一场最宏大、最可怕的奇观，换作以前，会让胜利者的脸颊流下眼泪。

sentences.en: But, he says, pity was stifled as it rose by the remembrance of the numerous and horrid atrocities that their unprincipled and bloodthirsty nation had been and were committing.
sentences.zh: 但是，他说，当回想起他们这个无原则、嗜血的民族过去和现在正在犯下的无数可怕暴行时，涌上心头的怜悯之情就被扼杀了。

sentences.en: And when she blew up, although I endeavoured to stop the momentary cheer of the ship's company, my heart felt scarce a single pang for their fate.
sentences.zh: 当它爆炸时，尽管我试图制止船员们瞬间的欢呼，但我的内心对他们的命运几乎没有一丝痛惜。

sentences.en: Nelson is softer-hearted, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 纳尔逊心肠更软一些，对吧？

sentences.en: And they rescue, what, about 70 survivors pulled up from the waters.
sentences.zh: 他们救起了大概70名幸存者，从水里拉了上来。

sentences.en: And the thing that's amazing, always strikes me about this, is that the sound is so deafening that for about 10 minutes, everyone stops fighting.
sentences.zh: 最神奇、也是每次让我最感意外的是，声音震耳欲聋，以至于大约10分钟内，所有人都停止了交火。

sentences.en: Obviously, the noise is ringing in everybody's ears.
sentences.zh: 显然，噪声在每个人的耳边回响。

sentences.en: And there is a kind of silence exceeds it because people can't carry on firing their own guns.
sentences.zh: 而且有一种超越它的寂静，因为人们无法继续开枪射击。

sentences.en: What's more, all they can hear is there's a steam, the hiss of the steam, but also the sound of thousands of fragments raining down on the waters.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，他们能听到的只有蒸汽，蒸汽的嘶嘶声，还有数千枚碎片如雨点般落入水中的声音。

sentences.en: So, bits of wood, bits of metal.
sentences.zh: 所以，到处都是木块、金属碎屑。

sentences.en: And, of course, they are, I mean, if you're in the sea and you have a bit of cannon fall on top of you.
sentences.zh: 当然，我是说，如果你身处大海，头上掉下一块大炮碎片。

sentences.en: Yeah, an anchor fall on top of your head.
sentences.zh: 对，一个锚砸在你头上。

sentences.en: That's not good, is it?
sentences.zh: 那可不太妙，对吧？

sentences.en: No, not at all.
sentences.zh: 不，一点也不妙。

sentences.en: There's an account by one lieutenant who wrote an account afterwards, and he said, he wrote it in the present tense.
sentences.zh: 有一位中尉事后写过一份记录，他说，他是用现在时写的。

sentences.en: So, after about 10 minutes, as you say, they hauled themselves up from the decks where they've been taking cover and start firing again.
sentences.zh: 所以，大约10分钟后，正如你所说，他们从刚才隐蔽的甲板上爬起来，重新开始射击。

sentences.en: And he wrote, and so the battle recommences, and the roaring of the guns, the crashing of the masts, and the shrieks of wounded, and the jargon of surrendering Frenchmen fill
sentences.zh: 他写道，于是战斗重新开始，大炮的轰鸣、桅杆的断裂、伤员的尖叫，以及投降的法国人的嘈杂声，充满了

sentences.en: up the remainder of this most memorable night.
sentences.zh: 这个最值得纪念的夜晚剩下的时间。

sentences.en: Yeah, and it carries on to, what, kind of the early hours of the morning?
sentences.zh: 对，而且一直持续到，什么，清晨时分？

sentences.en: One o'clock, two o'clock, something like that?
sentences.zh: 一点，两点，诸如此类？

sentences.en: Yeah, about two o'clock, I think.
sentences.zh: 对，我想大概两点吧。

sentences.en: And, essentially, they're just too tired by the end.
sentences.zh: 从根本上说，到最后他们实在是太累了。

sentences.en: And this is good news for Pierre-Charles Villeneuve aboard the William Tell, the Guillaume
sentences.zh: 这对于在“威廉·泰尔”号（William Tell，即吉约姆

sentences.en: Tell, because he essentially, I mean, you said even the French have had a good fight.
sentences.zh: ·泰尔号）上的皮埃尔-夏尔·维尔纳夫来说是个好消息，因为基本上，我是说，你连法国人也打了一场漂亮仗都说过了。

sentences.en: I mean, he hasn't really, he could have come up and helped, but he doesn't.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他其实没怎么参战，他本可以上来帮忙，但他没有。

sentences.en: And I think he's kind of torn between thinking, should I pile in, but I'll probably, you know, our ships will get sunk as well.
sentences.zh: 我想他当时内心很纠结，在想要不要冲进去，但可能会，你知道，我们的船也会被击沉。

sentences.en: Should I try and escape with what I can get from the ruin?
sentences.zh: 我是不是应该带着从废墟中能捞到的东西尽量逃跑？

sentences.en: And so, ultimately, he decides that that's what he'll do.
sentences.zh: 所以，最终他决定就这么办。

sentences.en: And so, his own ship, the Guillaume Tell, and the Genereau, which is another one, they get away, but all the others, they're either sunk or captured.
sentences.zh: 因此，他自己的船“吉约姆·泰尔”号，以及另一艘“热内罗”号逃脱了，但所有其他的船，要么被击沉，要么被俘。

sentences.en: And it is exactly the battle of annihilation that Nelson had wanted.
sentences.zh: 这正是纳尔逊一直想要的那场歼灭战。

sentences.en: Nelson hasn't lost a single ship, and it's an astonishing victory.
sentences.zh: 纳尔逊没有损失一艘船，这是一场惊人的胜利。

sentences.en: So, 11 ships of the line, two frigates, a brig, either captured or destroyed.
sentences.zh: 所以，11艘主力舰，2艘护卫舰，1艘双桅纵帆舰，要么被俘，要么被毁。

sentences.en: And only Villeneuve really lives to fight another day.
sentences.zh: 只有维尔纳夫真正活了下来，改日再战。

sentences.en: And, of course, he will live to fight another day, because he will be the commander who is defeated at the Battle of Trafalgar.
sentences.zh: 当然，他确实活到了改日再战的时候，因为他将是在特拉法加战役中被击败的指挥官。

sentences.en: And this is so important, because from this moment onwards, the gossip in Paris is that Villeneuve
sentences.zh: 这一点非常重要，因为从这一刻起，巴黎的流言蜚语都在说维尔纳夫

sentences.en: was frightened, and he ran away, and he, instead of standing and fighting, he fled.
sentences.zh: 吓坏了，当逃兵了，他没有坚守阵地战斗，而是逃跑了。

sentences.en: Now, Villeneuve was very upset by this.
sentences.zh: 维尔纳夫对此感到非常难过。

sentences.en: His argument was, you know, I got away, and everybody else was destroyed or captured.
sentences.zh: 他的辩解是，你知道，我逃出去了，而其他人全被消灭或俘虏了。

sentences.en: I didn't behave dishonorably.
sentences.zh: 我没有做出不光彩的行为。

sentences.en: I did the right thing.
sentences.zh: 我做的事是对的。

sentences.en: But this will play a part in the Battle of Trafalgar and in his decision.
sentences.zh: 但这将在特拉法加战役中以及他的决定中发挥作用。

sentences.en: Because he doesn't want to retreat again, does he?
sentences.zh: 因为他不想再撤退了，对吧？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: So, Nelson lost about just over 200 men.
sentences.zh: 所以，纳尔逊损失了略多于200人。

sentences.en: The French lost somewhere between 2,000 and 4,000.
sentences.zh: 法国人损失了2000到4000人不等。

sentences.en: And as you said, Tom, this is the most cataclysmic defeat for the French Navy.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，汤姆，这是法国海军最具灾难性的失败。

sentences.en: The most obvious effect is on Napoleon Bonaparte.
sentences.zh: 最明显的影响是落在了拿破仑·波拿巴身上。

sentences.en: He was in Cairo at his headquarters, which was in a kind of converted, you know, Ottoman townhouse.
sentences.zh: 他在开罗的指挥部，设在一栋改造过的奥斯曼风格的城市住宅里。

sentences.en: One thing I was wondering, I don't know whether you've come across this, I can't remember reading it, is whether by this point, Napoleon has a sense that Nelson is an adversary to
sentences.zh: 我一直在想一件事，我不知道你有没有遇到过，我不记得在哪里读到过，那就是到了这个时候，拿破仑是否觉得纳尔逊是一个令人

sentences.en: fear, to respect.
sentences.zh: 敬畏、需要尊重的对手。

sentences.en: Because he ends up having kind of bust of Nelson, doesn't he, on his mantelpiece?
sentences.zh: 因为他最后在壁炉台上摆了纳尔逊的半身像，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes, he does.
sentences.zh: 是的，他确实摆了。

sentences.en: Presumably, this is the moment where he really thinks, actually, here is a worthy adversary.
sentences.zh: 据推测，这就是他真正开始觉得，实际上，这是一个值得尊敬的对手的时刻。

sentences.en: I think so, yes.
sentences.zh: 我也这么认为，是的。

sentences.en: Would he have even known of Nelson's heroism at the Battle of Capus and Vincent?
sentences.zh: 他甚至会知道纳尔逊在圣文生角战役中的英雄事迹吗？

sentences.en: He might have heard of it, but he probably wouldn't have.
sentences.zh: 他可能听说过，但大概不会太清楚。

sentences.en: Probably he doesn't, actually.
sentences.zh: 实际上，可能根本不知道。

sentences.en: Because the news comes to him, and it is said that he basically takes the note and puts it aside, but the next morning, he's talking to his lieutenants, Napoleon this is, and he
sentences.zh: 因为消息传到他那里，据说他基本上把便条放在了一边，但第二天早上，他跟他的中尉们——我是说拿破仑——谈起此事

sentences.en: says to them, it seems you like this country.
sentences.zh: 并对他们说，看来你们很喜欢这个国家。

sentences.en: Well, that's lucky, because now we don't have any fleet to take us back to Europe.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这倒挺幸运，因为现在我们没有任何舰队能带我们回欧洲了。

sentences.en: And actually, the remarkable thing is he stays for another year in the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 事实上，最奇特的是他在中东又逗留了一年。

sentences.en: He delays the inevitable by launching his disastrous Gaza campaign, which basically sees the French
sentences.zh: 他通过发动灾难性的加沙战役来拖延无可避免的结局，这场战役基本上导致法军

sentences.en: army causing utter carnage in Gaza and then wandering hither and thither across the desert, stricken by plague and behaving very badly.
sentences.zh: 在加沙造成了极大的大屠杀，随后在沙漠中四处游荡，饱受瘟疫折磨，表现极其糟糕。

sentences.en: Basically, Napoleon, this is the first time that he does what would be a feature of his career.
sentences.zh: 基本上，这是拿破仑第一次做出后来成为其职业生涯特征的行为。

sentences.en: He scuttles back to France, abandoning his army, and he leaves them in the desert.
sentences.zh: 他抛弃军队溜回了法国，把他们留在了沙漠里。

sentences.en: So 40,000 men who went to Egypt with Napoleon, 15,000 were killed or very seriously wounded, and the rest all ended up as British prisoners.
sentences.zh: 因此，随拿破仑前往埃及的4万名士兵中，1万5千人阵亡或重伤，其余的全部成了英国的战俘。

sentences.en: So the whole campaign, which is, as you said, an extraordinary landmark in human history, is nevertheless an utter disaster.
sentences.zh: 所以整场战役，正如你所说，是人类历史上一个非凡的里程碑，但尽管如此，依然是一场彻底的灾难。

sentences.en: And from the British point of view, brilliant, because India is now secured as well.
sentences.zh: 从英国的角度来看，这太棒了，因为印度的安全现在也得到了保障。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: But beyond that, the Battle of the Nile, naval historians have often said this is a real turning point in world history.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，尼罗河战役，海军历史学家经常说这是世界历史上真正的转折点。

sentences.en: Ben Wilson, in his History of the Royal Navy, says it was undoubtedly the greatest victory in British naval history, because the French had control of the Mediterranean, and they
sentences.zh: 本·威尔逊在他的《皇家海军史》中说，这无疑是英国海军史上最伟大的胜利，因为法国人曾控制地中海，而他们

sentences.en: have definitively lost it.
sentences.zh: 已经彻底失去了这种控制。

sentences.en: Napoleon's army is trapped.
sentences.zh: 拿破仑的军队被困住了。

sentences.en: It has broken the image of Napoleon's invincibility, and it has permanently shattered the confidence of France's navy.
sentences.zh: 它打破了拿破仑战无不胜的神话，并彻底粉碎了法国海军的信心。

sentences.en: There was a French academic study in 1998, and they wrote about the Battle of the Nile.
sentences.zh: 1998年曾有过一项法国的学术研究，他们撰文谈到了尼罗河战役。

sentences.en: The Battle of the Nile is a battle of which French historians never speak.
sentences.zh: 尼罗河战役是法国历史学家从不提起的一场战役。

sentences.en: So this presumably is why Theo had never heard of it.
sentences.zh: 所以这大概就是西奥以前从未听说过它的原因。

sentences.en: Theo never heard of it?
sentences.zh: 西奥从没听说过？

sentences.en: Oh, come on, Theo, that's poor.
sentences.zh: 哦，拜托，西奥，这可真够逊的。

sentences.en: But I think more than that, so obviously it deals a devastating blow to the confidence of the French navy.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得不仅如此，显然这对法国海军的信心打击是毁灭性的。

sentences.en: Of course, it also boosts the confidence of those European powers who had withdrawn from the fight against France, and who now kind of think, maybe France isn't invincible after
sentences.zh: 当然，这也极大地鼓舞了那些曾退出对法战争的欧洲列强的信心，他们现在觉得，也许法国人并非

sentences.en: all.
sentences.zh: 不可战胜。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And of course, that is the great geopolitical goal for Britain, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 当然，这也是英国伟大的地缘政治目标，对吧？

sentences.en: It's not just to save India and to re-establish British naval control over the Mediterranean,
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是为了拯救印度并恢复英国对地中海的海军控制，

sentences.en: but to try and get the land-based allies that it needs, because it's not enough for Britain to avoid defeat.
sentences.zh: 而是为了争取它所需的陆上盟友，因为仅仅避免失败对英国来说是不够的。

sentences.en: It needs actually victory against France, and that means that they need allies with armies.
sentences.zh: 它实际上需要战胜法国，这意味着他们需要拥有军队的盟友。

sentences.en: Britain needs to keep winning victories at sea to get the Austrians and the Prussians back into the war to prosecute the defeat of the French on land.
sentences.zh: 英国需要不断在海上取得胜利，以拉拢奥地利人和普鲁士人重新参战，从而在陆地上彻底击败法国。

sentences.en: And of course, that will take a very long time, but in the long run, the British strategy does work.
sentences.zh: 当然，这需要很长时间，但从长远来看，英国的战略确实奏效了。

sentences.en: So Nelson holds a service of thanksgiving aboard the vanguard, and as a good vicar's son, he says, this is God's victory.
sentences.zh: 因此，纳尔逊在“先锋”号上举行了感恩礼拜，作为一名优秀牧师的儿子，他说，这是上帝的胜利。

sentences.en: The hand of God was visibly pressed on the French.
sentences.zh: 上帝之手明显压制了法国人。

sentences.en: It was not in the power of man to gain such a victory.
sentences.zh: 这不是人类的力量所能赢得的胜利。

sentences.en: So an Achilles, but a Christian Achilles.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是一个阿喀琉斯，但却是一个基督徒阿喀琉斯。

sentences.en: Yes, but his officers are in no doubt.
sentences.zh: 是的，但他的军官们对此深信不疑。

sentences.en: As Samarae writes to Napoleon, it was the most glorious and complete victory ever obtained, the just recompense of your zeal.
sentences.zh: 正如萨马雷写给拿破仑的那样，这是有史以来最辉煌、最彻底的胜利，是对你们热忱的正义回报。

sentences.en: And it has pleased Providence to give you the sight of these vile miscreants who've now received the just punishment due to their past crimes.
sentences.zh: 上天很高兴让你们看到这些卑鄙的恶棍，他们现在受到了因过去罪行而应得的正义惩罚。

sentences.en: But Samarae is in no doubt, it's Nelson's personal victory.
sentences.zh: 但萨马雷毫不怀疑，这是纳尔逊个人的胜利。

sentences.en: He calls a meeting of the captains, and they say, we will found an Egyptian club in honor of the victory.
sentences.zh: 他召集了各位舰长开会，他们说，为了纪念这场胜利，我们要成立一个埃及俱乐部。

sentences.en: When we get the club room, we will have a portrait of Nelson, and we will hang it there, and we will club together ourselves to buy Nelson a sword to thank him for leading us
sentences.zh: 当我们有了俱乐部房间后，我们将挂上一幅纳尔逊的肖像，我们还将集资为纳尔逊买一把宝剑，感谢他带领我们

sentences.en: to this amazing, amazing triumph.
sentences.zh: 走向这个无比惊人的伟大胜利。

sentences.en: And Dominic, just to say that Nelson likewise looks out for his captains, because of course
sentences.zh: 多米尼克，顺便说一下，纳尔逊同样关照他的舰长们，因为当然

sentences.en: we mentioned how Trowbridge doesn't take part in the battle because he's been stranded on this shoal.
sentences.zh: 我们提到过特罗布里奇因为搁浅在这处浅滩上而没有参加战斗。

sentences.en: And so in due course, when medallions are given to the various captains who had fought in the
sentences.zh: 所以在适当的时候，当奖章颁发给参加过尼罗河战役的各位舰长时，

sentences.en: Battle of the Nile, there was a move to deny Trowbridge his medallion.
sentences.zh: 曾有人试图剥夺特罗布里奇获得奖章的资格。

sentences.en: And Nelson was absolutely insistent that he have one.
sentences.zh: 而纳尔逊坚决要求必须给他一块。

sentences.en: That is nice.
sentences.zh: 这真好。

sentences.en: So that's the Band of Brothers in operation.
sentences.zh: 这就是“兄弟连”在起作用。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And Nelson, you know, he's such a romantic deep down, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 而且纳尔逊，你知道，他骨子里是个多么浪漫的人，对吧？

sentences.en: That Band of Brothers stuff that lots of people might scoff at, he loves that.
sentences.zh: 很多人可能会嘲笑的那些“兄弟连”式的作风，他却爱得不行。

sentences.en: And you can just imagine his officers telling him about this Egyptian club they're going to set up with a picture of him.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象他的军官们向他讲述他们将要建立一个挂着他画像的埃及俱乐部时，

sentences.en: And you can imagine kind of the manly tears springing to his eyes, Tom.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象热泪盈眶的男子汉气概涌上他的眼眶，汤姆。

sentences.en: You know, he would have absolutely adored that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他一定会对这一点爱不释手。

sentences.en: The news reaches Gibraltar and then Cadiz, and then it travels to the Admiralty in London.
sentences.zh: 消息传到直布罗陀，然后是加的斯，接着传到了伦敦的海军部。

sentences.en: It arrives on the 2nd of October, my birthday.
sentences.zh: 它在10月2日到达，那是我的生日。

sentences.en: A messenger is sent to the king, George III.
sentences.zh: 一名信使被派往国王乔治三世那里。

sentences.en: I love this.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢这个了。

sentences.en: This is almost my favorite episode in the whole history of Nelson.
sentences.zh: 这几乎是我在纳尔逊整个历史中最喜欢的一个情节。

sentences.en: The whole history of history.
sentences.zh: 整部历史中的整个历史。

sentences.en: The whole history of history.
sentences.zh: 整部历史中的整个历史。

sentences.en: There's nothing better than this.
sentences.zh: 没有比这更好的了。

sentences.en: The messenger to George III is crossing Hounslow Heath and is stopped by a highwayman.
sentences.zh: 派往乔治三世的信使正穿过豪恩斯洛荒原，被一名拦路强盗拦住了。

sentences.en: And when the messenger tells the highwayman what the packet contains, which is news of Nelson's
sentences.zh: 当信使告诉强盗信件包裹里装的是什么时，也就是纳尔逊在尼罗河大捷的消息，

sentences.en: victory at the Nile, the highwayman, without a word, hands him back the package and says, be on your way.
sentences.zh: 强盗二话不说，把包裹还给了他，并说：上路吧。

sentences.en: You know, what an amazing story.
sentences.zh: 你知道，多么惊人的故事啊。

sentences.en: There are bonfires and bells and fireworks in every theater.
sentences.zh: 每个剧院里都有篝火、钟声和烟花。

sentences.en: People are singing Royal Britannia.
sentences.zh: 人们在歌唱《统治吧，不列颠尼亚》。

sentences.en: It is the most extraordinary moment of national celebration.
sentences.zh: 这是全国欢庆最非凡的时刻。

sentences.en: And relief.
sentences.zh: 还有如释重负。

sentences.en: And relief, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然还有如释重负。

sentences.en: It's the kind of El Alamein, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这有点像阿拉曼战役，对吧？

sentences.en: It's El Alamein and Mafeking and Port Stanley rolled into one.
sentences.zh: 它简直是阿拉曼、迈菲金和斯坦利港的结合体。

sentences.en: Nelson is awarded a barony.
sentences.zh: 纳尔逊被授予男爵爵位。

sentences.en: He's a bit disappointed.
sentences.zh: 他有点失望。

sentences.en: That's the thing with Nelson.
sentences.zh: 纳尔逊就是这样的人。

sentences.en: He's always after more.
sentences.zh: 他总是追求更多。

sentences.en: He hoped he would be making a Viscount.
sentences.zh: 他原本希望自己能被册封为子爵。

sentences.en: But he hasn't got the money for it, has he?
sentences.zh: 但他没有那么多钱，对吧？

sentences.en: He hasn't got the money.
sentences.zh: 他没有钱。

sentences.en: This is the reason that he can't support a Viscount's lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 这就是他无法维持子爵生活方式的原因。

sentences.en: However, he's not going to go home just yet.
sentences.zh: 不过，他并不打算马上回家。

sentences.en: He now divides his fleet into three.
sentences.zh: 他现在把舰队分成了三部分。

sentences.en: So one group will remain at Alexandria to blockade the French and people who love blockades.
sentences.zh: 因此，一个小组将留在亚历山大港封锁法国人，那些喜欢封锁的人。

sentences.en: Tom, you've said how much you like blockades.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，你曾说过你有多喜欢封锁。

sentences.en: Perhaps you'd like to treat them to the story of that blockade in a bonus episode at some future point.
sentences.zh: 也许你以后可以在某一集的彩蛋里给他们讲讲那次封锁的故事。

sentences.en: Yeah, that'd be fun.
sentences.zh: 好的，那会很有趣。

sentences.en: I won't be there for that recording because I find blockades very boring.
sentences.zh: 我不会去参加那个录音，因为我觉得封锁太无聊了。

sentences.en: A second group escort the captured French ships to Gibraltar so they can claim the prize money.
sentences.zh: 第二组护送被俘的法国船只前往直布罗陀，以便他们能够领取赏金。

sentences.en: Really important, of course, for anyone in the Royal Navy.
sentences.zh: 这当然非常重要，对皇家海军的任何人来说都是如此。

sentences.en: And finally, Nelson himself will take the battered vanguard Alexander and Culloden to Naples so
sentences.zh: 最后，纳尔逊本人将带着饱经沧桑的“先锋”号、“亚历山大”号和“卡洛登”号前往那不勒斯，

sentences.en: that Britain's only real allies in the Mediterranean can hear the news of the battle at first hand.
sentences.zh: 以便英国在地中海仅有的真正盟友能够亲耳听到这场海战的消息。

sentences.en: And dominate not just the king and queen in Naples, but of course, the British envoys of William Hamilton and his delightful wife, Lady Hamilton.
sentences.zh: 并且不仅要让那不勒斯的国王和王后知道，当然还有英国特使威廉·汉密尔顿和他迷人的妻子汉密尔顿夫人。

sentences.en: Now, this is the end of the first season of Nelson.
sentences.zh: 好了，纳尔逊的第一季到此结束。

sentences.en: We'll be returning to his story in the spring.
sentences.zh: 我们将在春季回到他的故事中。

sentences.en: Would you like a little teaser, Tom, for the second season of Horatio Nelson?
sentences.zh: 汤姆，你想看看关于《霍雷肖·纳尔逊》第二季的精彩预告吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I'd love one.
sentences.zh: 好啊，我很想看。

sentences.en: And so, on the 22nd of September, the vanguard limped into the Bay of Naples.
sentences.zh: 因此，在9月22日，先头部队踉跄着驶入了那不勒斯湾。

sentences.en: Ahead lay the third largest city in Europe, simmering with danger.
sentences.zh: 前方是欧洲第三大城市，危机四伏，暗流涌动。

sentences.en: Although Nelson could hardly have known it, one of the darkest chapters in his life was about to begin.
sentences.zh: 尽管纳尔逊当时几乎不可能知道这一点，但他一生中最黑暗的篇章之一即将拉开序幕。

sentences.en: So, that is from your book, Dominic, Nelson, Hero of the Seas.
sentences.zh: 那么，这出自你的书，多米尼克，《纳尔逊：海洋英雄》。

sentences.en: And it's the perfect Christmas present for readers of all ages you've written down here.
sentences.zh: 你在这里写道，这是送给所有年龄段读者的绝佳圣诞礼物。

sentences.en: Now, as you said, we will be back continuing the story of Nelson in the spring.
sentences.zh: 正如你刚才所说，我们将在春季回归，继续纳尔逊的故事。

sentences.en: Obviously, we won't be covering the darkest chapter in Nelson's life.
sentences.zh: 显然，我们不会讲述纳尔逊生平中最黑暗的篇章。

sentences.en: I really don't think we need to bother with that.
sentences.zh: 我真的觉得我们没必要去管那个。

sentences.en: You don't reckon we'll do Naples at all?
sentences.zh: 你认为我们根本不会讲那不勒斯吗？

sentences.en: No, we don't need to bother with that.
sentences.zh: 不，我们不需要管那个。

sentences.en: So, we will be back with the Battle of Copenhagen.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们将带着哥本哈根战役回归。

sentences.en: Another brilliant victory for Nelson.
sentences.zh: 这是纳尔逊又一场辉煌的胜利。

sentences.en: I have to say, I think we will be doing Naples.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，我觉得我们还是会讲那不勒斯的。

sentences.en: So, people may want to skip that one if they don't want to hear anything bad about Nelson.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果人们不想听到关于纳尔逊的任何负面消息，可能会想跳过那一集。

sentences.en: So, if you can't wait, we have actually touched on most of the episodes that follow on from the Battle of the Nile in various previous episodes of the rest of history.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你等不及了，其实我们在《历史的其余部分》过去的各种节目中，已经涉及了尼罗河海战之后的大多数后续插曲。

sentences.en: So, William Hamilton, whose wife, Emma Hamilton, will be playing a leading role in the darkest chapter in Nelson's life.
sentences.zh: 那么，威廉·汉密尔顿，他的妻子艾玛·汉密尔顿将在纳尔逊人生的黑暗篇章中扮演主要角色。

sentences.en: He was on Love Island 2, so you can hear about him.
sentences.zh: 他曾参加过《爱情岛2》，所以你可以去听听关于他的节目。

sentences.en: The Battle of Copenhagen, Nelson's great victory in the Baltic, featured in the very early episode we did when we did one on England against Denmark for, it was Euros, wasn't it?
sentences.zh: 哥本哈根战役，纳尔逊在波罗的海的伟大胜利，曾出现在我们早期做过的一期节目中，当时我们做的是英格兰对丹麦，那是为了欧洲杯，对吧？

sentences.en: Euro 2020.
sentences.zh: 2020年欧洲杯。

sentences.en: So, we've done that and we've done a three-part series on Trafalgar.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们已经讲过这些，并且还做过关于特拉法加的三集系列节目。

sentences.en: So, you can kind of piece them together.
sentences.zh: 所以，你基本上可以把它们拼凑起来。

sentences.en: But we will be doing all of these in much more detail in the spring and it continues to be a remarkable and epic story and we will see you then.
sentences.zh: 但我们将在春季更详细地探讨所有这些内容，这依然是一个非凡而史诗般的故事，我们到时见。

sentences.en: But our next episode, we will still be in the Near East, but we will be exploring a time millennia before the age of Nelson as we go in search of the world's oldest city.
sentences.zh: 不过在我们的下一期节目中，我们仍将留在近东，但我们要去探索一个比纳尔逊时代早数千年的时期，去寻找世界上最古老的城市。

sentences.en: So, bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 那么，拜拜。

sentences.en: Goodbye.
sentences.zh: 再见。
